verdict.rationale: The evidence supports only part of the story. The vendor's AI features page mentions "sending bulk collection reminders," and workflow automation can "notify, update, or validate information," which points toward automated dunning for overdue customers. Invoicing appears only as a feature heading, and recurring invoices are never described. Missing for 10: any documentation of recurring invoice profiles or schedules, explicit automatic overdue-payment reminder configuration (timing, triggers, templates), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
